note: Keys of the BouncyCastle provider's remaining key factories: the EC factory's ECDH/ECMQV OIDs, ElGamal, GOST R 34.10-94, DSTU 4145, HSS/LMS, Falcon, NTRU, FrodoKEM, Classic McEliece, composite ML-DSA and ML-KEM (IANA and generic), the EXTERNAL factory, and GOST R 34.10-2001/2012 keys with X9.62 parameters. A valid key is read; OIDC needs a certificate and then refuses the key's family (its algorithm, upper case; a generic composite's null is the empty family) except GOST's (EC), whose token signing fails in SunEC; SAML accepts every key, RSA-SHA256 refuses it at SSO, ECDSA too except for GOST and DSTU keys, which BouncyCastle signs with on their curve. Malformed keys fail with the key factory's exception.
